subject: general
question: The function of a steering system is to convert the rotary movement of the steering wheel into:

options.text: angular turn of the front wheels
linear motion of the front wheels
angular turns of the rear wheels
angular velocity of the front wheels

solution:
The correct answer is __angular turn of the front wheels.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Steering systems__ are designed to control the direction of the vehicle.
 
• The primary function is to convert the rotary motion of the steering wheel into the angular movement of the front wheels.
 
• It ensures the vehicle is guided safely and accurately around bends and curves.
 
• Precise steering is essential for ensuring comfort, safety, and stability while driving.
 
• Modern steering systems include technologies like power steering for better control and reduced effort.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Linear Motion of Front Wheels:**

 
 
• This is not a function of the steering system as it does not involve direct linear motion.
 
 
 
• **Angular Turns of Rear Wheels:**
 
 
• Rear wheels do not steer in most conventional vehicles, except in advanced four-wheel steering systems.
 
 
 
• **Angular Velocity of Front Wheels:**
 
 
• This refers to the rotation speed of the front wheels and is not controlled by the steering system.
